About Us

SS Consulting Engineers Ltd

SS Consulting Engineers Ltd is a progressive Design and Build consultancy dealing in several areas within the building and construction industry. We have a team of qualified and experienced engineers, technicians, surveyors, site managers and project managers all offering quality customer service to our clients. The team has a wide range of experience in residential and commercial projects.

We provide sustainable and value engineering structural design and build solutions, customised to meet the unique needs of each client. Our approach is highly flexible, allowing us to adapt materials and techniques to suit individual projects.

We provide project management services. Let our experienced project managers handle every detail, so you can focus on your priorities without the hassle of dealing with builders directly.

We use the latest technology and innovative techniques for cost effective and enhanced quality solutions, including 3-dimensional models and Building Information Modelling (BIM) to achieve high quality and sustainability in our projects.

With a commitment to client satisfaction, efficiency and superior craftsmanship, SS Consulting Engineers Ltd stands as a trusted partner in bringing visions to life and achieving construction goals with precision and integrity.

Our Services

A Range of Consulting Services

From feasibility through to a structure that's actually standing, plus everything a project needs in between.

01

Project Management

We improve resource management, quality assurance, time management and cost management. You never need to deal with builders directly.

02

Civil / Structural Engineering Design

Sustainable, value-engineered structural design and build services, flexible in materials and techniques. Specialising in loft conversions, extensions, flat conversions, basements, retaining walls and refurbishments.

03

Architectural Services

Modern architectural services for client satisfaction and planning approvals.

04

Bespoke Design

Alternative construction methods based on client requirements, including reinforced concrete, structural steelwork, masonry and timber, plus complete structural design packages with detailed drawings and calculations.

Basement Design

Basement conversions are very popular in London. We provide design, detailed drawings and specifications for converted and new basements that meet Building Regulations.

Extensions & Conversions

Loft conversions in London are very popular. Extending is often a good, cost effective alternative to moving. Our experienced Structural Engineers provide a complete design package for loft conversions, including detailed drawings and calculations for Building Regulations approval. We also provide expert design solutions for rear, side and first-floor extensions, with full detailed drawings and stability calculations for submission. Our project managers deal with individual builders or sub-contractors on your behalf.

Structural Survey & Reports

We carry out structural surveys to check the existing condition of a property and produce technical reports explaining conditions found and recommendations for strengthening if required, considering areas of concern such as subsidence in detail.

Insurance Claims

We have resolved many insurance claims and complex technical matters on behalf of our clients, applying an innovative approach on challenging projects for the client's benefit.

Our Process

How a Project Runs

Six stages, always in this order. Each one sets the reference point for the next.

01

Survey

Topographic & ground data captured on site.

02

Concept

Options tested against constraints & brief.

03

Detailed Design

Structural & civil packages finalised.

04

Approvals

Planning & building control submissions.

05

Construction

Build phase, supervised on site.

06

Handover

As-built records & close-out.

Geospatial Analysis

GIS Consultancy

QGIS for site level analysis, Google Earth Engine for wide area monitoring, layered together to answer questions a single site visit can't.

Topographic & Constraints Mapping
